name: Motorcycle Simulator North Carolina
summary:
The ride of your life, from the seat - all the way round Charlotte, North Carolina.

YOUR GARAGE
Start astride your bike in a luxury three-car garage in South End. Touch the throttle and the door lifts onto the street.

THE BIKE
A litre-class sport bike: a live colour dash with speed, gear, lean angle and a map, two live mirrors, a smoked bubble screen.
